featured_reviews.name: jaivin shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
Mithil Sir is truly one of the finest science teachers I have ever learned from. He teaches science not just as a subject, but as a well-crafted story or a movie, where every concept connects logically to the next. This unique teaching approach activates our curiosity and makes even complex scientific principles easy to understand and remember.

The way he explains concepts is so engaging and concept-oriented that they get permanently embedded in our minds, almost like a strong chemical bond. His teaching ensures long-term retention rather than short-term memorization. Although he assigns slightly more homework compared to other science teachers, every task has a clear purpose — reinforcing concepts, improving problem-solving skills, and strengthening conceptual clarity.

His test series is scientifically structured and has played a major role in improving my understanding, confidence, and academic performance. It helps identify weak areas and gradually builds accuracy and speed. Having studied science under his guidance in both 9th and 10th standards, I can confidently say that his teaching has shaped my scientific thinking and learning discipline.

In conclusion, Mithil Sir is not just a teacher, but a mentor who transforms science into an enjoyable and meaningful experience. Undoubtedly, he is one of the best science teachers in South Bombay (Sobo).

featured_reviews.review_text:
I am extremely grateful to have studied Science under Mithil sir who is such a dedicated and inspiring teacher during my Class 9 and 10. Sir explains every concept with great clarity and patience, making even the toughest topics easy to understand. His teaching is not just exam-oriented but focused on building strong fundamentals, which helped me gain confidence in Science.
He is always ready to clear doubts, encourages questions, and genuinely cares about his students’ progress. The regular tests and special test series have  motivated me and played a huge role in my academic improvement.
He not only focuses on our academic improvement but also builds a personal bond by inviting students for cricket matches and welcoming us to his home to take Baapas blessings, making the learning journey truly special.
Thank you, Sir, for your constant support, hard work, and belief in us.
I would highly recommend any ICSE student to join Mithil Sir for Science and Maths  to truly excel academically and build strong conceptual foundations.

featured_reviews.name: Mishank Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
I was a student of Mithil Sir since the 9th and the 10th grade and have genuinely enjoyed with him a lot.
I am truly flabbergasted by the efforts he has put to make us understand the concepts clearly.
He teaches us passionately connecting science to small interesting stories and fun acronyms to help us remember difficult topics.
He hates making us mug up chapters like most other teachers do and instead sits with us for an extra hour putting each and every word in the textbook into our heads.
He won't let a single student go home with a doubt lingering in his/her head.
He does everything to keep us entertained by cracking random, short but funny jokes keeping us engaged and interested in the boring science lectures.
I will definitely remember the "faadu" spot tests, split-ups and  the "bhelpuri" prelims he made us write and those memorable reels we made together during class and ganpati festival at his house.
The one thing that can never leave my mind is the different kinds of words he used to call us, not holding offense or bcs he held a grudge over someone, but because he always wanted us to improve and be better and better.
The "baakda" was his favourite spot to make us do our pending homework along with the mosquitoes toteach us a proper lesson.
He scolds us oftenly but holding an intention to make our scores better.
Overall, he is the best science teacher I could ever have and I am really sad that our journey with him ends so soon.

Thank You very much for making our science journey so exciting and memorable💓💓💓

featured_reviews.name: Aditya Kadakia
featured_reviews.review_text:
The last 2 years were nothing less than fun learning, practical application, out-of-the-box thinking, and a rather unorthodox way of teaching but those very paths have made the tough concepts of science nothing less than a cakewalk for us. We have been taught the core values of discipline, endurance, patience and hardwork under the pretext of classes taken by you.

Moral values always outweigh bookish lessons tenfold and that very lesson was taught just as good as the academic classes. The effort taken by you to carefully make our prelim papers, split up papers or even for the most basic spot test paper is tremendous and we are always indebted to you for that effort as it makes a very crucial binding force between the teacher and the student. Such efforts are often left unnoticed by many but always prove to be helpful during the board examinations.

Your concept building batch for the tenth stardard, during the month of May was utmost useful for us as it proved to be extremely efficient and completely expeditious for us as well as you. All the cricket played was definitely challenging and nothing less than a 2 hours, fun filled, energy packed, thrilling time which was worth spending. All the new and intersting aartis for ganpati bappa were interesting and fun to sing.

Sir, you are a very inspiring and influential figure and have paved a very critical way of our lives for us.
You were never limited to being a teacher, but rather a mentor, who helped us not only academically but also in the various spheres of life. Finally, the time of partition has arrived and it has proved to be rather painful, and i would like to conclude with the fact that no amount of words can completely express our gratitude for you and your work done for us. After all that is done by you, the least we can ask for, is your blessings and help us gain success and reach a high apex in our lives.

With a mind full of knowledge, and a heavy heart, we have to bid adieu to your classes. Respectfully, signing off.

featured_reviews.review_text: I had joined Mithil Sir for Std. 9 and 10 for Science. He is the best teacher one could possibly ask for. His methods of teaching are great, and children remember the concepts taught by him even after years have gone by. featured_reviews.name: Danesh Guleria
featured_reviews.review_text:
Der Mithil sir
Thank you for being far more than just a teacher over these two crucial years of Class 9 and 10. You were a guide, a mentor, and quietly, a constant force of belief when we doubted ourselves the most. Science, under you, might have been a little intimidating  but it was more over approachable, logical, and almost elegant. You had a rare, remarkable ability to explain the most complex concepts with such ease and clarity that confusion dissolved into understanding, and my fear turned into curiosity.

You never limited learning to the textbook. All your notes and print outs helped us more than any authored text. You pushed us relentlessly yet thoughtfully to attempt new papers, unfamiliar questions, and challenging tests. Yes, we failed in almost every single class at some point, but under you, failure was never humiliating. It was instructive. It was purposeful. You taught us that falling short was not the end, but the beginning of real learning. Each mistake became a stepping stone, each re-spot test a lesson carved into memory.

Because of your discipline, patience, and unwavering dedication, good marks will follow not by chance, but by effort shaped under your guidance. Beyond academics, you gave us experiences that built connection and trust: turf parties filled with laughter, and the warmth of visiting your home during Ganesh festival, where teacher and student blurred into something more human, more meaningful.

You are inspiring, insightful, endlessly encouraging, and profoundly impactful. Your teaching was not just effective it was thoughtful, passionate, and deeply transformative nurtuting us to push our limits. These two years will forever remain a beautiful chapter of learning, growth, and gratitude, and you will always be remembered as one of my most wonderful teachers I was lucky enough to have.

With immense respect and heartfelt thanks to you Sir !!!

featured_reviews.name: Myrra Joshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have had a very positive experience at PW Vidyapeeth Borivali East. The faculty members are highly knowledgeable, supportive, and always willing to address students’ queries with patience and clarity. They ensure that every student understands the concepts thoroughly and encourage active participation in class.

The overall academic system is well-organized and student-friendly. Classes are conducted in a structured manner, study materials are helpful, and regular tests help students track their progress effectively. The staff is cooperative, and the learning environment is motivating and focused.

What stands out the most is the dedication of the teachers towards students’ success. Their guidance, mentorship, and constant support make learning much more effective and enjoyable. I would highly recommend PW Vidyapeeth Borivali East to students preparing for competitive examinations and looking for quality education in a disciplined environment.

featured_reviews.name: SARVESH JOSHI
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am currently studying at PW, and my experience has been excellent. The faculty members are highly knowledgeable, supportive, and dedicated to helping students understand even the toughest concepts with ease. Their teaching style is clear and student-friendly, which makes learning enjoyable and effective.

The staff and other team members are also very cooperative and always ready to help. The study material, classes, and overall environment are well-organized and focused on student success.

I truly feel that PW provides quality education at an affordable price, and I am grateful to be a part of it. Highly recommended for all students who want strong conceptual understanding and proper guidance.

featured_reviews.name: Unnati Singh
featured_reviews.review_text: I’ve had an amazing experience at this institute! The teachers are super supportive and always ready to clear even the smallest doubts, which really helped me build confidence for JEE.The environment is positive and motivating — everyone here actually wants you to do your best. I really love how the classes are interactive and how the teachers make tough topics feel so easy to understand. The regular tests and discussions also keep me on track.And also SST and other staffs are also sweet...

featured_reviews.name: Utsav Singh
featured_reviews.review_text: Unfortunately, my experience with this zoology teacher has been quite disappointing. There are frequent mood swings and an evident ego issue, where even respectful disagreement from students is not tolerated, regardless of whether the student is correct. A healthy learning environment should encourage open discussion, but here, students often feel suppressed and unheard. Additionally, there have been instances where students are discouraged or demotivated regarding their career choices instead of being guided positively. Education should build confidence and curiosity, not fear or self-doubt. I hope this feedback is taken constructively to improve the overall teaching approach and student experience.

featured_reviews.name: virendra sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am very disappointed with my experience at PW Vidyapeeth Borivali. When I enrolled, the institute promised high-quality teaching, proper academic support, and a structured environment for serious exam preparation. Unfortunately, the reality has been very different from what was promised.

The teaching faculty is not up to the level required for competitive exam preparation. Many classes lack depth in concepts, and the explanations often feel incomplete or rushed. For students preparing for tough exams, strong conceptual clarity is extremely important, but the teaching here does not consistently meet that standard.

Another major issue is that several services and academic support systems that were promised during admission are either poorly implemented or not provided properly. Students expect guidance, doubt-solving sessions. I request one who see this review please don't waste your money by enrolling in borivali vidyapeeth instead purchase the online batch.
